claims.text: A car pulls forward out of the dark.
No spoken or sung lines are allowed.
The audio reference is a low engine rumble.
The setting is a lightless space with a faint pool of ambient light ahead; the car's body is barely readable at first and is revealed progressively as it advances.
The engine rumble remains low, continuous, and slightly uneven throughout the advance.

subjects.description: A dark, generic passenger car whose body is gradually revealed by ambient light.

references.description: A low engine rumble used as the beat and pacing reference for the car's measured advance.
references.retention_details: Used only as a beat reference for the low, continuous engine rhythm; no full soundtrack copy is implied.

summary.text: A car pulls forward out of darkness, resolving from a faint silhouette into a complete body under a low ambient glow while a low engine rumble continues.

description.text: Near-total darkness fills the frame, with no measurable horizon and almost no background detail beyond a soft black field and the faintest suggestion of ground beneath the wheels.

sits ahead, angled slightly across the space, its silhouette so faint that only the roof line, hood edge, and one shoulder of the body are perceptible. No chrome, badge, or interior detail is readable; the vehicle reads as a massing of shadow rather than a finished object. A very low ambient glow touches the nearest surfaces just enough to separate the car from the darkness, but it does not yet reveal color or material. The wide view makes the emptiness around the car feel larger than the vehicle itself. The only clear sensory anchor is the low engine rumble, steady and close, while the scene remains visually withheld in shadow.
appears only as a faint, low-contrast silhouette in a wide, dark frame.
A low engine rumble is already present and continuous.
remains motionless for a beat, its outline barely separated from the surrounding darkness.

noses forward into a narrow, faint pool of ambient light just beyond the dark threshold. The movement is slow and heavy, the front bumper and headlamp housings crossing first while the rear of the body stays buried in shadow. As the nose enters the light, the bodywork gains a muted sheen: a soft highlight runs along the hood's leading edge, and the grille and lamps begin to resolve from flat black into shallow shapes. The surrounding space remains sparse, with no other objects or landmarks visible; the light appears to come from an unseen source ahead, creating a gentle gradient across the floor and fading quickly behind the vehicle. The body stays level and deliberate, and the low rumble continues without rising into a rev, keeping the moment quiet and mechanical.
The low engine rumble carries over the cut, steady and close.
noses forward, the front bumper and headlamp housings entering the light first.
A soft highlight gathers along the hood's leading edge as the grille and lamps begin to resolve.

rolls fully clear of the darkness, and the complete body becomes readable in the ambient light. The front end, cabin, and rear now hold a continuous outline; the surfaces remain subdued, with no bright reflections or hard speculars, only soft modulations that suggest painted metal, glass, and shadowed wheel arches. The car continues forward at the same measured pace, moving through the shallow pool of light rather than stopping inside it. Around the vehicle, the setting stays intentionally bare: a dark floor, a dim gradient at the edges of the frame, and no signage, figures, or scenery to distract from the emerging shape. The low engine rumble remains even and close through the final moment.
The low engine rumble continues, even and mechanical.

soundscape: A low, continuous engine rumble with slight mechanical unevenness; no other sounds.
